description_en: Lvahãlã Phalcā is located in Lvahãlã Ṭola. It faces east. A person by the name of Cikiti Bhāvo and other members of the community facilitated the construction of the Phalcā in 1795 CE (NS 915). It was initially only one storey high. In 2008 CE (VS 2065), it was reconstructed from its base up. The Lalitpur Municipality contributed NR 660.000 for the reconstruction. During the reconstruction, another floor was added. The top floor is used by the Ṭola Sudhāra Samiti (neighbourhood committee) as their office. An undated Svayambhū Caitya stands in front of the Phalcā. An inscription inside the Phalcā mentions that the Caitya was there before the Phalcā was built. After the reconstruction, statues of Lakṣmīnārāyaṇa, Saṅkaṭā, Kṛṣṇa, Rām-Lakṣmaṇa-Śita, and Nārāyaṇa were established in the Phalcā’s northern wall.Bhajanasinging takes place here on on Sakimilā Punhi (full moon day of Kārtika) andIndra Jātrā(full moon day of Bhādra). Similarly, month-longBhajanais performed throughout the month of Guṃlā and in Māgha. The Phalcā was badly damaged in the 2015 CE earthquakes and is since supported by timber braces.
description_ne: ल्वहंलँ टोलमा रहेको यो फल्चा पूर्वाभिमुख गरी दुई तलाको बनाइएको छ । नेसं ९१५ (सन् १७९५) मा चिकिति भावो लगायत टोलका अन्य मानिसहरू मिलेर यो फल्चा बनाइएको थियो । पहिले फल्चा बनाउँदा एक तलाको मात्र थियो । पुरानो फल्चा जीर्ण भएपछि जगैदेखि भत्काएर विसं २०६५ (सन् २००८) मा फल्चाको पुनर्निर्माण गरिएको थियो । फल्चा पुनर्निर्माण गर्न ललितपुर महानगरपालिकाबाट ६ लाख ६० हजार रकम प्राप्त भएको थियो । पहिलेको फल्चा एक तलाको मात्र भएपनि पुनर्निर्माणपछि दुई तलाको बनाइएको थियो । फल्चाको माथिल्लो तलामा अहिले टोल सुधार समितिको कार्यालय राखिएको छ । फल्चाको अगाडि स्वयम्भू चैत्य स्थापना गरिएको छ । यो चैत्यको निर्माणकालबारे कुनै अभिलेख प्राप्त भएको छैन तर फल्चा स्थापना हुनुभन्दा अघि नै चैत्य स्थापना भइसकेको कुरा फल्चामा राखिएको शिलापत्रबाट थाहा हुन्छ । फल्चाको पुनर्निर्माण भएपछि उत्तरतिरको पर्खालमा लक्ष्मीनारायण, संकटा, कृष्ण, लक्ष्मण-राम-सीता, नारायणका मूर्तिहरू स्थापना गरिएका थिए । यस फल्चामा कार्तिक शुक्ल पूर्णिमा, इन्द्रजात्राको दिनमा भजन गरिन्छ । त्यस्तै गुंला र माघ महिनाभरि पनि भजन गरिन्छ । विसं २०७२ (सन् २०१५) को भूकम्पले यो फल्चामा क्षति पुगेकोले टेको लगाइएको छ ।

historical_events.event_description: In 2008 CE (VS 2065) the derelict Lvahãlã Phalcā was reconstructed. Lalitpur Metropolitan City contributed a sum of Rs 660,000 to this process. During the reconstruction, another floor was added as well as iron railings that could be locked.
A person named Cikiti Bhāvo and some others contributed to the construction of the Phalcā.

historical_events.event_name: Offering of praying wheels and a dalūcā
historical_events.event_description: Candramāyā Śāhī offered four praying wheels and adalūcāto the Svayambhū Caitya.
Cirikājī (Gvāthyā) Maharjana offered a copperilā̃to the Svayambhū Caitya in the memory of his deceased parents.
The Phalcā was damaged by the 2015 earthquakes. Since then, local residets fixed timber braces to support the Phalcā.
